newsitem.title: UK: British Data in merger talks with Mentmore.
newsitem.headline: British Data in merger talks with Mentmore.

text.p: Mentmore Abbey said on Tuesday that merger discussions were taking place with the board of British Data Management, an information resource management and archive storage company.
But it noted in a brief statement: "However, it is too early to say at this stage whether or not terms can be agreed."
Mentmore Abbey, the UK stationery and housewares business formerly known as Platignum, said it was making the statement in response to recent newspaper articles linking the two groups.
Shares in Mentmore Abbey edged two pence higher to 81.5 pence, valuing the group at just under 30 million stg.
British Data Management's shares slipped 0.5 pence to 179.5p, valuing that company at around 45 million stg.
